acceptance: The gate reports, per benchmark and engine, which queries compared empty reference results, and does not count them as proven.
Queries empty at the gate scale get non-empty evidence (data augmentation such as the second-warehouse setup from #3426, chosen seeds, or a larger scale), or are listed as unproven with reason.
Reintroducing the unpadded-date defect makes the gate fail.
description: The SQLite unpadded-date defect (TPC-DS and OBT Q16/Q94/Q95 filtering on NULL bounds) survived make sql-execution-gate and make tpcds-obt-equivalence because at SF0.01 those queries return no rows on DuckDB for every seed (one warehouse). tests/integration/test_tpcds_obt_equivalence.py documents EMPTY at line 26. An empty-vs-empty comparison proves nothing about translation.
